messages.subject: Re: geom_tile: controling color and adding text to plot
parts:
David,

1) You want to use scale_colour_manual( values=..., breaks=... ); see
its help page, which gives examples of doing exactly what you want.

2) ...+geom_text(aes(label=z),size=2)

HTH,
Ben


On Sun, Oct 28, 2012 at 8:43 PM, David Guy
<rstatistica...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hello ggplot2 team members,
>
> It is a first for me with ggplot2 and I am working a graph using the
> geom_tile functionality. So far I am getting the plot the way I want it;
> however, I am not finding the correct syntax, what might be simple for you
> guys, for the following tasks:
>
> 1] how do I control the colors for each tile so I can define specific colors
> for specific z values?
> 2] how can I add the z value from the data frame to the plot such that it is
> inside each of the tile squares?
>
> The data df is an x,y,z numeric data frame.
>
> The code I have so far reads:
>
> p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=x,y=y))
>
>
> p+ geom_tile(aes(fill=z))+ scale_fill_gradient(low="green", high="blue")
>
> Thank you for your help.
>
> David
